notes: Use the map as a reference for the following steps. When picking a side, the reward is almost the same for both:
Rewards may only be obtained during or upon completion of the quest, and can never be reclaimed afterward.

steps.text: Speak with Ceril Carnillean ( of the house south-west of East Ardougne castle)
Siding with Ceril will reward 5 additional coins and gives you the option to obtain Carnillean armour, although this armour has lower defensive bonuses than an iron platebody.
Siding with Hazeel will reward the Hazeel's mark, which is a purely cosmetic reward.
Turn Valve 1 LEFT
Turn Valve 2 RIGHT
Turn Valve 3 RIGHT
Turn Valve 4 RIGHT
Turn Valve 5 RIGHT
Enter the Ardougne Sewers east of the clocktower (south of Valve 3) and talk to Clivet
Board the raft, and talk to Alomone to the south.
Kill Alomone and loot the Carnillean armour from the chest.
(Optional) If you want extra pieces of armour, multiple can be obtained using the drop trick. It can not be reobtained after the quest.
Board the raft again and run back to the Carnilleans house.
Talk to Ceril Carnillean (quest incomplete!)
Search the cupboard in the room upstairs east of the staircase to find the evidence.
Enter the Ardougne Sewers east of the clocktower (south of Valve 3) and talk to Clivet to receive a bottle of poison
